operating_mode: After explicit authorization, run continuously through the next safe gate; do not solicit approval packet-by-packet unless a stop condition is reached.
repository_discipline: Inspect current branch, remotes, worktree and existing stack
Create or use a protected feature branch; never mutate main directly unless user explicitly instructs
Prefer small coherent commits aligned to execution packets
Record chosen versions and architecture conformance in EP-00
verification_discipline: Generate consumers from approved contracts; no handwritten duplicate models
Run the narrowest relevant test during editing, then packet exit suite
Use deterministic fakes before live integration
Browser-verify every implemented route and critical state
Do not mark human gates passed without recorded human evidence
Maintain an execution ledger with packet, commit, tests, failures and remaining gates

packets.entry_criteria: Approved UI-04 plus explicit clean-session implementation authorization
packets.exit_criteria: Record runtime/package/browser support matrix, lockfile, repository conventions and CI baseline

packets.name: Generate contract consumers

packets.name: Build shell and accessibility infrastructure

packets.name: Campaign entry and Issue Zero

packets.name: Living Stage read composition

packets.name: Intent-to-resolution action loop

packets.name: Durable reconnect and recovery
packets.exit_criteria: Preserve draft/idempotency/cursor/checkpoint references across simulated loss and cold restart

packets.name: Character and progression

packets.name: Company, relationships and Relic agency

packets.name: Holdings, custody and projects
packets.exit_criteria: Implement checkpoint, destructive confirmation and custody authority paths

completion_target: QA-ready protected preview candidate with automated evidence complete; production release remains a separate decision.
